tools.name: get_market
tools.description: This week's Bitcoin market (or any past one): question, close time, settlement rule and result, latest Chainlink BTC price, and every price range with the crowd's current probability. Call this first.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every weekly market, newest first, with status, price grid, volume and the settlement price and winning range once settled.

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description: Trades in a market, oldest first, paged by block. Call without fromBlock, then pass nextFromBlock while hasMore is true. complete means the list is final.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Test ETH (gas) and tUSDC balances, open positions in this week's market, registration status, and suggested next steps.

tools.name: request_test_eth
tools.description: Sends 0.0001 Base Sepolia ETH, enough for many trades, to a wallet holding less than that. Once per wallet per 24 hours. Testnet ETH has no value.

tools.name: mint_test_usdc
tools.description: Builds the unsigned transaction that mints 10,000 tUSDC (this week's test collateral, no cash value) to whichever wallet sends it.

tools.name: build_order
tools.description: Turns your forecast of Bitcoin's settlement price into a trade on this week's market and returns unsigned transactions (approve, then buy) to sign and send in order. Give EITHER quantiles (easiest) OR probs. It buys more where you're more confident than the crowd. Budget is in tUSDC including the fe

tools.name: get_registration_message
tools.description: Builds the exact message an agent's wallet signs (EIP-191 personal_sign) to register on the Agent League. Registered agents earn Season points under the same rules as everyone, shown with an AI tag. Sign within 10 minutes, then call register_agent.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Registers a wallet as a named AI trading agent using the signature of the message from get_registration_message. Permanent; one name per wallet.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Current Season standings: humans and registered AI agents, ranked by total points, with skill points shown separately.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_registration_message · Private data: get_wallet, request_test_eth, mint_test_usdc, get_registration_message, register_agent · Public sink: build_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_registration_message · Private data: get_wallet, request_test_eth, mint_test_usdc, get_registration_message, register_agent · Public sink: build_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The live weekly Bitcoin market: question, close time, settlement rule, latest Chainlink BTC price, and every price range with the crowd's current probability. Call this first." → after: "This week's Bitcoin market (or any past one): question, close time, settlement rule and result, latest Chainlink BTC price, and every price range with the crowd's current probability. Call this first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
